# xqshare

A small browser share widget (inline bar, centred `pop` dialog, edge `slide` tab)
shipped as a UMD global, an ES module and a Vue 2 / Vue 3 component. Share icons
are bundled, so it works offline with no runtime CDN dependency.

## Install

```sh
npm i xqshare
```

## Imports

```js
// CommonJS (also the UMD build; the module *is* the constructor)
const XqShare = require('xqshare');

// ESM — default and named export are the same class
import XqShare, { XqShare as NamedXqShare, buildShareUrl } from 'xqshare';

// Vue 2 / Vue 3 plugin, registers the component as `xqShare` (<xq-share>)
import xqshare from 'xqshare/vue';
import 'xqshare/css/xqshare.min.css';

// Browser <script>: exposes the global `XqShare`
// https://unpkg.com/xqshare/lib/js/xqshare.min.js
// https://unpkg.com/xqshare/lib/css/xqshare.min.css
```

Import paths that exist: `xqshare`, `xqshare/vue`, `xqshare/css/*`,
`xqshare/lib/vue/index.vue`, `xqshare/lib/*`, `xqshare/package.json`.

## Exported API

- `XqShare` (default + named) — the widget class. `new XqShare(options)` needs a
  live DOM; it throws when `document` is undefined (SSR) and when `el` does not
  resolve (`XqShareError` code `host-missing`). `XqShare.version` is a string.
- `XqShareError` — `Error` subclass with a stable `code`:
  `bad-el | host-missing | bad-mode | bad-target | popup-blocked`.
  Message text is prefixed `XqShare Error: `; match on `code`, never on text.
- `buildShareUrl(type, payload): string | null` — encodes the destination URL.
  Returns `null` for `wechat` (no web endpoint) and for unknown names; never throws.
- `getShareTarget(name): ShareTargetDefinition | null` — `{ name, label, icon, build }`.
- `isShareTargetName(value): value is ShareTargetName` — type guard.
- `DEFAULT_TARGETS` — `['qq', 'qzone', 'weibo', 'douban', 'tieba']` (what the
  widget renders when `targets` is omitted).
- `SHARE_TARGETS` — all six definitions, including `wechat` (opt-in).
- `ICON_CDN_BASE` — `https://xqgj.cc/xqcdn/libs/xqshare/img/`, the last-resort icon base.
- `VERSION` — package version string.
- Types (no runtime value): `XqShareOptions`, `ResolvedOptions`, `ShareMode`,
  `ShareTargetName`, `CopyTarget`, `CopyMethod`, `CopyResult`, `SharePayload`,
  `ShareResult`, `XqShareErrorCode`, `VueApp`, `XqShareVuePlugin`.

## Key Options

- `el` — **required**, `string | Element`. Must already be in the document.
- `type` — `'default' | 'pop' | 'slide'`, default `'default'`. Only `pop` renders
  the URL / iframe copy fields and the close button.
- `url` — default `location.href`. Always encoded by `buildShareUrl`.
- `title` — default `document.title`.
- `desc` — default `meta[name="description"]`, else `''`. Used by `qq` / `qzone`.
- `targets` — subset and order of the six names. Unknown name throws `bad-target`
  (duplicates are dropped). `wechat` copies the link instead of opening a tab.
- `iconBase` — directory with a trailing slash for `share_*.png`. Default: the
  directory next to the loaded script/module, else `ICON_CDN_BASE`.
- `visible` — default `type !== 'pop'`, so a `pop` widget starts hidden.
- `closeOnMask` — default `true`; backdrop click closes `pop` only.
- `onShare(ShareResult)` — after a destination is triggered; `opened` is `false`
  for `wechat` and for a blocked popup.
- `onCopy(CopyResult)` — after a clipboard write, including the `wechat` path.
- `onToggle(visible)` — on every open / close caused by `show()` / `hide()` /
  `update()`, not on the initial silent mount.
- `onError(XqShareError)` — recoverable problems. Also `console.warn`-ed.

## Instance

- `element: HTMLElement | null`, `visible: boolean`, `mode: ShareMode`,
  `options: Readonly<ResolvedOptions>` (getters; `element` is `null` after `destroy()`).
- `show()`, `hide()`, `toggle(): this`
- `share(type, url?, title?, desc?): ShareResult` — unknown `type` is reported via
  `onError` and returns `opened: false`.
- `copy(target = 'url'): Promise<CopyResult>` — `target` is `'url' | 'iframe'`;
  legacy ids (`'#previewUrl'`, `'#iframeUrl'`, `'code'`) are still accepted.
  Resolves with `method: 'failed'` instead of rejecting.
- `setUrl(url, title?): this` — updates the shared URL and the copy fields.
- `update(patch): this` — re-resolves options and rebuilds the markup in place
  (no duplicate nodes or listeners). Throws `bad-el` after `destroy()`.
- `destroy(): void` — removes the markup, every listener and the scroll lock;
  idempotent.

## Vue component

`<xq-share>` props: `type`, `url`, `title`, `desc`, `targets`, `iconBase`,
`closeOnMask`, `show` (Vue 2), `modelValue` (Vue 3). Events: `update:modelValue`,
`update:show`, `share`, `copy`, `toggle`. There is no `onShare` prop — use
`@share`. The component owns exactly one `XqShare` instance and destroys it on
`beforeUnmount` / `beforeDestroy`.

## Typical Use

```js
import XqShare from 'xqshare';
import 'xqshare/css/xqshare.min.css';

const widget = new XqShare({
  el: '#shareHost',        // must already exist
  type: 'pop',             // starts hidden; call widget.show() to open
  url: location.href,
  title: document.title,
  targets: ['qq', 'qzone', 'weibo', 'wechat'],
  onShare: (result) => console.log(result.type, result.opened),
  onError: (error) => console.warn(error.code),
});

widget.setUrl('https://example.com/post/1', 'Post title');
widget.show();
// SPA unmount:
widget.destroy();
```

## Constraints

- Browser only. Bundles target ES2018; no Internet Explorer. Chrome 63+,
  Edge 79+, Firefox 58+, Safari 12+.
- The markup is injected as `innerHTML` and every hook is a `data-*` attribute
  scoped to the instance root — never query `.xqshare-*` globally, and do not
  reuse one instance across two hosts.
- Popup blocking is reported through `onError('popup-blocked')`, not thrown.
  `share()` must run inside the click handler to keep `window.open` alive.
- `copy()` needs a user gesture for `navigator.clipboard`; otherwise it falls
  back to `document.execCommand('copy')` and reports `method: 'execCommand'`.
- When the JS is bundled (webpack/vite/rollup) the auto-detected icon directory
  may point at a hashed asset path. Set `iconBase` explicitly (copy `lib/img/`
  to your public dir, or pass `${ICON_CDN_BASE}`) if icons 404.
- Styles are required: `pop` guards its closed state with inline styles, but the
  bar and slide layouts, transitions and icon sizing come from `xqshare.css`.
- Fine-grained integration notes ship in `skills/xqshare/SKILL.md`
  (`package.json#agents`).
